_shape: Shows. `upcoming` and `past` share the same fields; the page sorts each by date and moves nothing between them automatically. Only `date` is required — every other field renders only if present, so a show with an unconfirmed venue simply shows without one rather than with an invented one. NOTHING here is generated: `past` was imported from 'Morphics Performance History.xlsx' (28 shows compiled from tagged fliers, Sep 2018 - Dec 2024) and is acknowledged incomplete — pre-2018 and unlogged dates are missing.

_fields.date: ISO date, e.g. 2026-09-12. For a multi-day run, the FIRST day — it is what the list sorts on.
_fields.date_display: Optional override for what's shown, e.g. '8–11 Aug 2019' or 'Dec 2019' when the day is unknown.
_fields.title: Event or billing
_fields.venue: Venue name. Omit if genuinely unconfirmed.
_fields.ticket_url: Upcoming only — link out to the ticket seller
